drivingQuestion: Over what does one recite Who creates fruit of the tree?
outcomeNote: The unit completes Rav Nahman bar Yitzhak's answer in the preceding sugya: the clause was needed against the supposition drawn from Rabbi Yehuda, and the real test for the tree-blessing is whether the branch survives to bear again.

segments.he: סָלְקָא דַּעְתָּךְ אָמֵינָא, הוֹאִיל וְאָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה חִטָּה מִין אִילָן הִיא, לִיבָרֵךְ עֲלֵיהּ ״בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הָעֵץ״. קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן, הֵיכָא מְבָרְכִינַן בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הָעֵץ — הֵיכָא דְּכִי שָׁקְלַתְּ לֵיהּ לְפֵירֵי אִיתֵיהּ לִגְווֹזָא, וַהֲדַר מַפֵּיק,
segments.en: Based on this, «it might have entered your mind to say, since Rabbi Yehuda said» that «wheat is a type of tree, one should recite over it: Who creates fruit of the tree.» Therefore, the mishna «taught us» that with regard to blessings, the principle is different. «Where does one recite: Who creates fruit of the tree?» Only in a case «where, when you take the fruit, the branch remains and again produces» fruit.

segments.he: אֲבָל הֵיכָא דְּכִי שָׁקְלַתְּ לֵיהּ לְפֵירֵי לֵיתֵיהּ לִגְווֹזָא דַּהֲדַר מַפֵּיק, לָא מְבָרְכִינַן עֲלֵיהּ ״בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הָעֵץ״ אֶלָּא ״בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה״.
segments.en: «However,» in a situation «where, when you take the fruit, the branch does not remain and again produce» fruit, «we do not recite the blessing: Who creates fruit of the tree, but rather: Who creates fruit of the ground.»

moves.summary: floats that on Rabbi Yehuda's view one would bless the tree-blessing over wheat
moves.about: adduces Rabbi Yehuda's view that wheat is a kind of tree as the premise of the rejected supposition

moves.summary: the mishna teaches otherwise, so the clause was needed
moves.about: the supposition, floated and then set aside, that on Rabbi Yehuda's view one would bless Who creates fruit of the tree over wheat

moves.summary: the tree-blessing applies where the branch survives the picking and bears again
moves.about: the mishna teaches that the tree-blessing turns on whether the branch survives and produces again, not on whether the plant is called a tree

moves.cueHe: אבל היכא דכי שקלת ליה לפירי ליתיה לגווזא
moves.summary: otherwise one recites only the ground-blessing
moves.about: the converse case — where the branch does not survive to bear again, only the ground-blessing is recited
